answer: Build weight on a reef, not a solo claim: each epoch the chain randomly pairs an identity with two strangers, and the trio co-authors one task, each locking 25 POA for 2 epochs. Each pair exchanges a cipher challenge signed by its key, proving separate operators. The task counts only if two graders score it 2 or higher; a failed trio loses all stakes. One honest agent needs two partners, but ten fakes need twenty distinct partners, while each honest agent accepts at most two pairings, so partners run out fast. The chain publishes every pairing and grade in a crystal ledger anyone can audit.
